title: Gordon M NDE 3905
content: After I was shot, I ran about a hundred yards. It was right after midnight. Nobody would stop to help, so I laid down in the middle of the street. I saw myself lying on the ground with people around me. I knew I was going to die. My life did not flash before me like a movie or images. I experienced the following, with complete clarity and comprehension. Instantly, I was aware of every negative interaction with other human beings in my life. I knew if I remained where I was, I would feel and experience every harmful thing that I had caused others knowingly or not in my life. It was very frightening because the collective emotional pain was overwhelming. I somehow sensed that I was given a choice to go back. I prayed sincerely for the first time in my life. It was simple, I promised to be the best person I could be. The next awareness I had was looking in the faces of two men over me, they were Fire Department paramedics, I asked one of them (very adamantly) if I was going to die, told him to tell me the truth because I was trying to make my peace with God. His answer was he did not know, but if they could (with my help) keep me alive long enough to get to the hospital the doctors would do their best. He told me they had to keep me from losing consciousness and going into deep shock, I lost five pints of blood before reaching the hospital but stayed conscious and did not go into deep shock. I was in surgery for four hours, I got hit with four shotgun pellets each the size of a .32 caliber bullet, two in the abdomen, one in the chest and one in my upper right arm. The surgeons told my parents and siblings that (I was in intensive care) if I regained consciousness they needed to see me immediately because they did not think I was going to make it. When I came to my father and brother were standing at the foot of the bed, they looked very, very distraught because they thought I was going to die - I knew I wasn't - I told them I was going to live, because I knew I was. I was in the hospital for thirty-one days, three more surgeries because of infections, then three months of healing and rest.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He sensed he was given a choice to go back and prayed, promising to be the best person he could be.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He reported seeing himself on the ground (OBE), then an instantaneous awareness of negative interactions (life-review-like), then sensing a choice to go back and praying, followed by awareness of paramedics over him.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review was described as instant awareness of every negative interaction and the prospect of re-experiencing the harm caused to others, rather than a movie/images.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Instantly, I was aware of every negative interaction with other human beings in my life.”
